fact: Car 81 moved forward from its start position, prior to the start signal.
offence: Breach of Article 48.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, team and in-car video evidence. The video evidence clearly showed the car moving prior to the start signal for the race was given
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 81 False Start Moving Before Signal
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
